    Profile

    Neica is one of the most outstanding Alchemia Mages in the whole of Babel. Because she's always felt a lot of pressure from her surroundings, she's extremely shy and withdrawn. She's actually quite fascinated by other people, but she can't bear meeting people face to face. Observing them from afar is the best she can manage. She feels most at ease in solitude.

    Origin: Gluttony Foss
    Gender: Female
    Height: 152cm
    Weight: 54kg
    Birthday: Jan 30
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Reading, human kind's power
    Hobbies: Crafting accessories
    Illust: やもり
